title: Throughput Signalizer microbenchmark and regression sentinel
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a resilient microbenchmark harness ("Throughput Signalizer") that produces stable tokens/sec signals and p95 latency fingerprints for our core serving models and alerts on regressions. The harness must produce reproducible steady-state TPS numbers across hardware variants, include KV/cache warmup sequences, support both synthetic and sampled real-prompt mixes, and integrate with CI and Grafana-based alerting.

Success criteria:
- Stable baseline TPS and p95 for each model variant (variance < 5% across 5 runs).
- Automated regression detection: a CI job that fails on >=10% drop in median TPS or >=15% increase in p95 compared to pinned baseline.
- Canary pipeline that runs lightweight checks on model rollouts and triggers fallback policies when thresholds breach.
- Dashboarding: per-model time series for TPS, p95, CPU/GPU utilization, KV hit rate, and sample output quality metric.
- Documentation and runbook: how to add a new model, how to interpret the signal, and remediation steps.

Approach:
1) Harness: implement a standalone runner in runtime/benchmarks/signalizer that spawns realistic clients with configurable concurrency profiles, prefix warmup, and token-length distributions. Provide JSON scenario files for synthetic and sampled prompt sets.
2) Baselines: establish pinned baselines for the core models (rwd-1, rwd-2-small, rwd-chat) with hardware tags (A100-80GB, H100-80GB, T4).
3) CI integration: add nightly and per-PR smoke jobs. Use stable-seed prompt sampling to ensure comparability.
4) Regression detection: implement a comparator that computes both relative and absolute deltas and reports a human-friendly summary in PR checks with links to diffs.
5) Observability: emit metrics to prometheus and surface Grafana panels and alert rules. Include a p95 drift alert with 30m rolling window and hysteresis.

Artifacts: design doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/TPSSignalizer, initial PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1298, dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/throughput-signalizer.

Acceptance criteria: harness merges to main, nightly baselines populated, CI job created and green for at least 3 consecutive runs, and at least one real regression detected and triaged during canary tests.
